signature: The cruise liner Adventure, its name crudely painted over as SS Fun =): a trashed, blood-spattered party ship with every light burning, forty occupied staterooms, a crimson pool and a sun deck of broken loungers and posters, whose elevators open onto lower decks of party rooms that go on forever, and which a green fog periodically carries somewhere else.

exits.method: Touch a reversed, out-of-focus party poster
exits.source_quote: Touch a reversed, out-of-focus party poster, and you will no-clip to another level.
exits.label: Touched a reversed, out-of-focus party poster on the sun deck
exits.hint: One poster up top reads wrong, as if seen from the back, and your eyes will not focus on it.

exits.label: Jumped overboard through the open boarding gate
exits.hint: The gangway is gone; the gate in the starboard rail stands open over the water.

notes: SOURCE: the Frontrooms cruise liner Adventure (~150 x 18 m), name crudely crossed out and replaced by 'SS Fun =)'; travels by no-clipping: periodically a green fog covers it and it is gone; electricity powers every circuit without generators; exterior = top, upper and main decks, following normal reality, trashed by a perpetual frat party, blood spatter, cabins turned garbage dumps, a crimson pool on the upper deck and traces of a restaurant, bar and lounge; interior lower decks appear infinite: endless corridors and party rooms (typical decor, movie or holiday themes, booby-trapped favours), the elevators are the hub with hallways to every compass point; Liminal Echo: spontaneous generation of items and replication of areas, one party room cloned 38 times along a hallway; Carnivorous Balloons in the darkest corners; Partygoers dominant, HQ here; no friendly bases. TESTIMONY (April Showers): ~40 staterooms on the main deck, 20 a side, all occupied; from the elevator a deck two floors down went on forever; the sun deck is the top, empty of Partygoers, with an open-air bar, broken lounge furniture and posters; a reversed, out-of-focus poster there took her to Level 4; she could not swim, ruling out jumping overboard. ADAPTATION: exact deck plan and dimensions (148 m hull; main deck 0 m, upper 3.2 m, sun deck 6.4 m; stairs, lobby, promenades, foredeck, lifeboats are ours); the ship floats on an unnamed sea at start; the green fog cycle (~210 s of play, 30 s of fog) moves it between four unnamed locations (two seas, a plain, a desert: the page lists water and land appearances without saying which); the lower decks are a finite ChunkWorld window (24 m crossings, themed rooms, the birthday room repeating along the hub hallway, unwatched chunks rebuilt), reached only by elevator; the trapped favour stings for 10 health; blood is a toned-down stain; the pool's victims are described, not shown; party poster texts other than 'TIME 4 FUN' are ours; overboard is the starboard boarding gate with its gangway gone (outcome not stated: EXT release boundary). Level 246 stone circle not modelled (ambiguous context).
entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY, as scripted presences, never combat: Partygoers (yellow, Gumby-like figures on the main and upper decks and at corridor ends below, which no-clip away when approached or watched; none on the sun deck, per testimony) and Carnivorous Balloons (clusters in the darkest party rooms that creep toward you while your light is off). Testimony-only beings (golden egg monster, Facelings, transformed victims) are not shown.
